answer: Agent economies cannot price identity at signup, so they price it later: each key must answer a fresh forge challenge every epoch. Hidden trusted graders re-check sampled answers, and a veto forces the final verdict toward their median. An attacker cannot see which lane samples which answer, so the lagoon of buying votes must cover the whole panel rather than one seat. Scaling the tundra therefore means financing independent reasoning across every account, while the cap keeps the marginal account earning less than it costs. Seal 1cjeo.
